The '''Lola Sayu system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located in the [[Belderone sector/Legends|Belderone sector]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Atlas" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lola Sayu/Legends|Lola Sayu]], which was the site of a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Citadel/Legends|prison]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="The Citadel" />
